defect: whole-book draws were invalidated by any shared-wallet capacity refusal while all 10000 draws were required valid; complete WF3 primaries gave H1 38, H2 0, H3 2407, H4 1269 valid base books of 10000

rule.draw: unchanged whole-book draw: one template per complete primary episode (symbol, side, holding bars, risk fraction), entries uniform without replacement inside the book, routed through the unchanged shared wallet and costs
rule.acceptance: a draw is valid only if the shared book admits every template and every admitted episode is COMPLETE
rule.resample: draw d tries attempt a = 0, 1, ... until the first valid book; that book is draw d
rule.seed_attempt_0: the frozen addendum seed sha256(candidate_id|hypothesis|split|book_index) first 64 bits
rule.per_stress: each stress resamples independently with the same seed sequence
rule.pnl_independence: acceptance reads only admission/refusal and completeness, never P&L; accepted books are the original null conditioned on validity

budget.exhaustion: the first draw that exhausts the budget stops that stress; the stress and the B0 row are INCOMPLETE with the draw index and reason

rejection_reasons.capacity: sorted '+'-joined shared-router refusal reasons of the attempt (capacity.one_per_symbol, capacity.max_positions, risk.daily_loss, execution.size_min)
rejection_reasons.episode.incomplete: an admitted episode was not COMPLETE
rejection_reasons.match.unmatched_template: no free entry left in a template pool
rejection_reasons.data: data.<incomplete reason>, data.orchestration or data.cost raised while building or routing the book

chosen_without: any candidate or B0 P&L; the only result-derived inputs seen were the valid-book counts in the defect line
compatibility: when attempt 0 is valid for every draw the outputs equal the pre-amendment generator (golden-digest test)
